SCAR SC 9mm Conversion.info:
Converts your MK16 SOCOM SC to fire 9x19mm using a conversion kit.
Uses a 50rd drum magazine.
Focusses on CQC by increasing the fire rate, close range damage and reducing the recoil but at the cost of ranged damage, bullet speed and penetration!

GB .50 AE Conversion.info:
Load your GB-22 with .50 AE.
 This makes it a GB-50. The larger bullet brings greater damage, but worse recoil and less ammunition carried.

DBV 30-06 Conversion.info:
A 30-06 conversion kit for the AK-12/76, with a rifled barrel and bolt capable of handling the new round. A popular sporting cartridge, the 30-06 round packs a powerful punch at all ranges.

Very high damage with a below average rate of fire.

AUG A3 7.62x39 Conversion.info:
Converts your UAR A3 to fire 7.62x39mm.
Increases damage and penetration at the cost of high recoil, lower bullet speed and a slower reload time.

Vector .22LR Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your Vector into .22 Long Rifle.
Kills overall performance, but is really nasty with headshots and aiming is a little faster.
Comes with a 20 round magazine. Reloading this thing will be a breeze!

AUG A2 7.62x39 Conversion.info:
Loads your F90 MBR with .224 Valkyrie.
Uses special 25rd magazines made for the Valkyrie cartridge.
Significantly increases ranged bullet performance both in damage and velocity but less powerful towards limb damage up close and increases recoil.

FT300 308.info:
Load your FT300 with the .308 Winchester cartridge.
A heavier cartridge than .243 Winchester with a slightly lower velocity. More power with improved performance in long range, good if you want something between power for close range engagements and velocity for longer range engagements.

OBREZ 410.info:
You won't believe what Zarovian farmers are doing this time!
Convert your worn out MOSIN MAGANT (OBREZ) into a modern day FROLOVKA OBREZ that fires 410 bore rounds!

M1911 .22LR Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your M1911 into .22 Rat Shot.
Why would you do this to yourself? Basically you have a mini shotgun...

S-12 223 Conversion.info:
Load your SAIGA-12 with .223 Remington.
Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.

HK337 .300 Conversion.info:
Converts your M416 to fire 6.8x43mm SPC!The 6.8mm Special Purpose Cartridge is an intermediate rifle cartridge developed to possibly replace 5.56x45mm.
While it offered superior lethality up close with minimal loss of magazine capacity and negligible increase in recoil, it began to falter at longer ranges and was dropped due to logistical and cost issues.

SHORTY 5.56 Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your FAL into 5.56x45mm NATO.
Adjusted performance befitting of the caliber it is firing.
Comes Packed with standard issue 30-round STANAG Magazinse.

GB 12G Conversion.info:
Somehow load your GB-22 with 12 gauge minishells.
 This makes it a GB-12.
More pellets for greater damage, but horrid muzzle velcoity and less ammunition carried.

Vector 9mm Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your Vector into 9x19mm.
Bigger mag with slightly less recoil, but at the cost of damage, velocity, and a bit of range!.

Remington 700 .32 ACP Adapter.info:
Not you again!
Simple metal adapters allow the use of 7.65mm rounds without any major modifications.
Vastly improved weapon speed, including action and reloading with poor damage and velocity as a tradeoff because your absolute priority is speed.

.300 Win-Magnum (WA2K).info:
A large cartridge introduced by the Winchester Repeating Arms Company in 1933.
Significantly powers up your WA2000 at the cost of ammo capacity and significantly higher recoil!

e Shotgun Penny Conversion.info: Instead of large discs you loaded the magazine with pennies. That's one way to spend your money... your reserve ammo now equates to about 3 dollars.

USC 40 Conversion.info:
Changes the ammunition fired from your PDC-45 with .40 S&W.
Allows for a lethal one shot to the head at close range. Increases fire rate, bullet speed and lowers recoil at the cost of general body damage and range.

SCAR-H 6.8 SPC Conversion.info:
Converts your MK17 SOCOM to fire 6.8x43mm SPC using a MK16 lower receiver!
It was experimented by the Grand Federation back around 2011 with limited examples.
Offers above-average assault rifle performance with a standard 30rd magazine capacity and similar fire rate to the MK16 SOCOM!

FIVE-0 45ACP Conversion.info: Convert your FIVE-0 into firing .45 ACP, increasing magazine capacity at the cost of close up damage. Slight rate of fire increase.

SVK12E 12.7 Conversion.info:
A rechambering of the SVK-12 for the relatively uncommon 12.7x55mm ammo type, typically used by special forces and police units for higher stopping power. Like many of the other AK-12 prototype variants, no real credible info exists on the development of this rifle in this chambering.

Very high damage with somewhat low muzzle velocity..

SKORP Rubber Bullets.info:
Load your Skorpion with .32 ACP Rubber Bullets.
Ammunition usually used by police in riot control. Improved damage to the body which falls off tremendously fast.

FAL 5.56 Conversion.info:
Converts your FAL 50.00 to fire 5.56x45mm NATO.
Feeds from 30rd STANAG magazines. Significantly improves recoil while keeping a strong damage profile with high bullet speed but will still reload slower than your average assault rifle!

SPR .308 Conv.info:
Uses .308 Winchester, a stronger round with higher bullet speed, penetration, improved damage ranges and better head/torso damage!
Slight increase in camera recoil but also exclusively uses 10 round magazines, you will however get better walk speed, handling and a faster reload!

M1911 Dart Conversion.info: Change the ammunition fired from your M1911 into a single dart. Deals more damage, but with worse recoil, low bullet velocity and less ammunition carried.
